title: Santorini and Scarborough comparison grid
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y5 lesson 12 (Santorini and Scarborough comparison grid (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 12: Settlements and tourism: a Greek island and a British seaside town. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

panels.title: Tourism in Greece
points: More than 30 million visitors a year recently

model.title: One effect of tourism on Santorini

parts.text: Effect: crowded streets and pressure on water
So: limits on visitor numbers have been discussed

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Tourism brings money but also crowding

keywords.def: find what is the same and different

questions.q: Write one similarity and one difference.
questions.a: Similar: both coastal, both have tourists. Different: Santorini has hotter, drier summers

questions.q: Core: In the portal response box, write a comparison of Santorini and Scarborough with two similarities and two differences. Starter: 'Both places ...'
Extend: Explain one good and one bad effect of tourism.
questions.a: For example: jobs; crowds and traffic

questions.q: Stretch: Suggest one way to make tourism fairer for local people.
questions.a: For example: limit cruise ships; spread visitors across the year

questions.q: Which is true of both places?
questions.a: B) Coastal tourist towns. Both are coastal and rely on tourism; the other two only fit Santorini.

questions.q: Big question: is a Greek seaside town very different from a British one?
questions.a: Some differences (climate, buildings) but many similarities (coast, tourism, harbours)
